Fixed. In `axum/src/routing/mod.rs:4488-4497`, requests that fail route matching due to a missing/extra trailing slash are no longer redirected (`Redirect::permanent` + `replace_path` logic removed); all unmatched paths — including trailing-slash mismatches — now go to the fallback (404 by default), per the issue. Unused `Redirect`/`IntoResponse` imports were dropped.

- `cargo test -p axum --lib`: 202 passed, 0 failed (including `not_found_for_extra_trailing_slash`, `not_found_for_missing_trailing_slash`, `with_and_without_trailing_slash`, `wildcard_with_trailing_slash`)

- The 2 `--doc` failures (`TypedHeader`/`axum::headers` examples) are pre-existing on the unmodified baseline and unrelated.
